planets.name: Kepler-296 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-296 with a 34.1-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-296 e was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-296. Its orbit and size follow Barclay et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BARCLAY_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2014, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 5; pl_orbper 34.14176909, pl_radj 0.13649746, pl_bmassj 0.0093

quotes.title: Kepler-296e
quotes.card: Kepler-296e is a confirmed super-Earth exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of Kepler-296.
quotes.introduction: The planet was discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft using the transit method, in which the dimming effect that a planet causes as it crosses in front of its star is measured.
